body.description: Doña Chayo, a stout middle-aged market trader: red hair tied back, teal dress with a white apron, bangles, warm bossy face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
